items.text: Introduced a resolution, adopted by one vote, calling on the government to end a bilateral agreement that gives nationals of one country their own rules for residence, work, and family reunification. The resolution does not bind the government.
Introduced a bill making unlawful presence in the country a criminal offence again; amendments stripped it and the party withdrew it.

Its 2024 program, adopted before this period, pledges an emergency law ending citizenship by birth on the country's soil, replacing free medical care for people without legal status with cover for life-threatening emergencies only, and faster removal of foreign offenders. In this period it voted for both restrictions put to a vote and introduced a bill making unlawful presence a crime again, which affirm that program.
